newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 index tracks U.S. shares lower.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 index tracks U.S. shares lower.

text.p: UK shares ended lower on Friday as pre-election nerves and the possibility of a near-term interest rate rise combined with a weaker opening on Wall Street to halt an eight-day rally in blue chips.

The FTSE 100 index of leading shares finished 18.8 points lower at 4,369.7 for a net gain of 59 points on the week and 98 points over two weeks. Losing stocks outweighed gainers at the close by roughly two-to-one.
"At the 4,400 level the market was looking very toppy," said one senior dealer. "We were expecting a quiet correction and we haven't ended badly considering the election is next week."
